product.title: Tahoe Coastal Self-Guided E-Bike Tour on East Shore Trail

description.text: Explore Lake Tahoe at your own pace on a self-guided electric bike rental along the car-free East Shore Trail. Ride from Incline Village toward Sand Harbor, stopping whenever you choose for photos, swims, or lunch with helmet, lock, and parking included.

highlights: Self-guided e-bike rental on the East Shore Trail
Car-free bike path away from highway traffic
Flexible two-, three-, or four-hour rental windows
Helmet, bike lock, and parking fees included
Route ends at Sand Harbor beach area

start.description: Pick up your e-bike next to Starbucks at 893 Tahoe Blvd, Incline Village, NV 89451.

end.description: Return your e-bike to the Incline Village pickup location.

faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 to 4 hours.
